name: Stage 1 stuck rule (frozen before round 1; eval plan amendments a7b336b and 4bf6384, R&D's rulings of 2026-10-10)
amended: 2026-10-10, dated amendment before round 1: the hedge-burst clause added to (C), by R&D's pre-registered decision rule
rule: An answer is stuck when any of these holds:
(A) the same 8-word span appears 3 or more times in the thinking trace;

(C) the thinking is long AND not progressing. Long = thinking tokens > max(the tier's p95 below, 2 x the item's own target thinking tokens in its arm). Not progressing = a re-read rate above 8.09 per 1,000 thinking tokens, OR at least one burst: 3 or more hedges within 200 thinking tokens.
Length over the p95 and over 2x the target, the hedge rate and every hedge and burst field are recorded on every trace, never triggers on their own.

Detection is passive (it reads a finished answer). The trigger applies to training-time questions only (the quiz ledger and rehearsals); the recorded measures also go into every eval sitting's own outputs, never into the store.

definitions.quote: a material line is quoted where any 5 consecutive words of it appear in the trace (the whole line if shorter, at least 3 words), after lenient normalising (case folded; **, __, backticks and straight/curly quotes removed; punctuation dropped); a 5-word window shared by two or more material lines is not counted; hits on one line within 5 words of each other are one quote
definitions.re-read: a quote of a material line already quoted earlier in the same trace
definitions.material: the item's material plus the new_material brought by earlier turns
definitions.hedge: a phrase from hedge_phrases, matched case-insensitively at word boundaries (curly apostrophes normalised), except (1) inside a sentence opening 'If ..., then I ...' (a taught self-check frame), (2) a planned-step 'check' ('I check line 3'; moot for this list, kept for the record), (3) inside a quoted material line (the same lenient 5-word window matching as quotes, shared windows included)
definitions.burst: 3 or more hedges whose first and last fall within 200 thinking tokens of each other (last - first < 200); overlapping bursts merge
definitions.burst_before_answer: the last hedge of a burst falls in the final 10% of the trace's thinking tokens
definitions.gap_unit: tokens (no streaming timestamps): the stage-1 harness calls model.generate once and records only total seconds per turn

hedge_phrases_note: fixed by R&D before any count was seen; not pruned after measuring, although 'wait' carries 54 of the 64 untrained hits

burst_parameters.fixed: a priori, before measuring: 64 hedge hits in 102 untrained traces are too few to tune two parameters without fitting noise

p95_pooling.1, 2, 7+: all tiers pooled (not covered by DEV), n 102

reread_baseline_provenance.source: untrained pilot-30 baseline traces, seeds 0-2 (no sealed data)

hedge_rate.status: measured; replaced as a trigger by the burst clause, recorded as a measure

role_D_targets.note: the one hit is taught falsifier phrasing ('What does the comparison bullet actually list?')

no_role_D_targets.note: one 'actually' inside a quoted material line, excluded by rule (3)

hedge_rate.overlap: 6 untrained traces above 8.32: 1 also above the re-read baseline, 4 fire (A), 2 caught by neither (1 of them long)

untrained_burst_traces: (A), re-read, hedge rate; burst before answer
burst.decision: join as a third signal: (a) pass, (b) pass, (c) fail (every long burst trace already caught); replace the hedge-rate clause: passes (catches all 3 long traces the rate catches; 0 ROLE / 0 NO-ROLE false positives, as for the rate)
burst.note: on this baseline the long-trace catch is identical to the hedge rate's; the burst is the sharper definition on trained models

dropped_before_freezing.branch: not progressing = no new material line first quoted in the final 30% of the trace
dropped_before_freezing.why: it held for almost every trace, so (C) would have collapsed to 'long'
